# Coverage and limits

The bounded model checks two units in one repository and cooperating operations within one delivery run. Actual-code tests check plan/source approval, clean workspace and branch binding, dependencies and writer ownership. Run the packaged checker against the packaged hash manifest; no historical private run is included.

This does not establish cross-run/global writer exclusion, real user consent, tracker freshness, screenshot/build authenticity, runtime business acceptance, SIT or deployment. Read actual plan sources and inspect other run owners before product edits. Mutation self-tests operate on temporary copies only.
